plugins.name: ag-grid
plugins.description: AG Grid Enterprise development plugin for Angular. Provides expert guidance on AG Grid Enterprise setup, column definitions, row models, filtering, cell rendering/editing, row grouping, pivoting, master-detail, and Excel export. Includes the ag-mcp MCP server setup skill for version-specific doc search inside your IDE.

plugins.name: angular
plugins.description: Angular 21 full-stack development plugin. Covers standalone components, NgRx Signal Store, Angular libraries, PrimeNG, ESLint/Prettier setup, sakai-ui conventions, and testing with Vitest.

plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Shared primitives for git, GitHub, and Azure DevOps workflows. Provides common git operations (branch creation, commits, push), GitHub pull request management, and issue linking.

plugins.name: copilot-workspace
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot workspace setup for GravionLabs/apm-hub contributors. Includes gh-agents-md to scaffold an AGENTS.md repository context file. Issue workflow skills automate the full branch → implement → review → PR lifecycle.

plugins.name: csharp
plugins.description: C#/.NET full-stack development plugin. Covers project setup, NUnit testing, async/await, code review, XML documentation, design patterns, EF Core, ASP.NET APIs, OpenAPI, MCP servers, .NET upgrades, modernization, Playwright .NET testing, and containerization.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Cross-cutting DevOps tooling. Publish code reviews as PR comments to GitHub or Azure DevOps, configure the az CLI azure-devops extension for pipeline integration, and create GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows using GravionLabs/ci reusable workflows.

plugins.name: docker
plugins.description: Docker containerization plugin. Optimized multi-stage Dockerfiles for any language or framework.

plugins.name: go
plugins.description: Go development plugin for idiomatic Go applications. Covers module structure, error handling, interface design, concurrency patterns, table-driven testing, code review, benchmarking, debugging, and containerization.

plugins.name: helm
plugins.description: Helm chart development plugin for Kubernetes packaging. Covers chart structure, values.yaml design, named templates, security contexts, OCI distribution, Helmfile, and chart upgrades.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: CLI-based Playwright testing plugin for .NET, Python, and Angular. Includes test generation, debugging, and language-specific patterns.

plugins.name: postgresql
plugins.description: PostgreSQL development and administration plugin. Schema design, query optimization, performance diagnostics, code review, Row Level Security, JSONB, and SQL best practices.

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Python development plugin. Covers project setup with uv, pytest testing with fixtures and markers, type hints, code review, Playwright Python testing, and containerization.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security and resilience tooling. STRIDE threat modeling, security compliance review. Tech-stack agnostic — usable alongside any language plugin.

plugins.name: shared
plugins.description: Shared agents, instructions and skills used across all GravionLabs apm-hub packages. Includes general-purpose SE agents, code review and markdown instructions, and reusable skills for test writing and skill creation.

plugins.name: terraform
plugins.description: Terraform infrastructure-as-code development plugin. Covers module design, naming conventions, state management, security best practices, code review, and multi-cloud provider configurations.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript and Node.js development plugin. Covers strict typing, ESM modules, async/await patterns, error handling, code review, debugging, Playwright TypeScript testing, and containerization.

plugins.name: all
plugins.description: Meta-package that installs all GravionLabs apm-hub packages in one step.
